push.privacy: For push, we store your approximate location (~1 km) and your reminder settings on our server, solely to send reminders. Disabling deletes the data immediately.
push.aboutText: If you enable reminders and your device supports Web Push, our server stores only your browser's push address, your location rounded to about 1 km with its timezone, the calculation settings and your reminder settings — solely to send prayer and dhikr reminders. No account, no other data. Turning off all reminders deletes this data immediately.

about.title: About & Sources
about.subtitle: Transparency about data sources & content
about.appDescription: Mobile-first Progressive Web App for Muslims. Free, no ads, no user data shared.
about.quranApi: Data via quran.com API v4 — free, no API key required
about.quranNote: Quran text provided by quran.com. All rights belong to the respective translator or provider.
about.hadithNote: All hadiths are from recognised, authentic collections (Sahih or Hasan grade). Translations are meaning-based, not word-for-word.
about.duaNote: Arabic texts taken from classical sources. Transliterations are provided to support correct pronunciation.
about.prayerApi: Calculated via Aladhan API (aladhan.com) — free, no API key
about.prayerMethodsVal: {count} methods (ISNA, MWL, Karachi, Egypt and more)
about.prayerNote: Prayer times are calculated mathematically. Local deviations are possible. For authoritative times, please consult your local mosque or official calendar.
about.mapsBody: Mosque search uses OpenStreetMap data via the Overpass API (overpass-api.de). Your saved location is sent to that service — only when you start a search.
about.calendarApi: Hijri conversion via Aladhan API — holidays stored as static Hijri dates
about.calendarNote: The Islamic calendar is based on moon sightings. Local dates (especially Ramadan, Eid) may vary slightly by region.
about.disclaimerText: This app is intended for spiritual support and information. All content has been compiled carefully, but without guarantee of completeness or accuracy. For religious rulings and decisions, please consult qualified Islamic scholars or your local mosque.
